name: WriteTlbEntryForSetUp
evidence: the TLB set-up's own copy of system call stub 0x56, called by SetUpTlbEntries with an entry's index, page mask, EntryHi and two EntryLo words

name: SetUpTlbForMemory
evidence: sets the TLB up through func_001FAA00 when QueryMemorySize reports 0x2000000, and calls the system call stub func_001F6D30 otherwise

name: SetUpTlbEntries
evidence: reports the three entry ranges, writes the kernel, default and extended tables of D_00277FE0 into the TLB with WriteTlbEntryForSetUp (wiring the first two) and maps every remaining entry empty from 0xE0000000; prints the "TLB over flow" messages and ends the program when a range passes 0x30 entries (SetUpTlbForMemory calls it)
